fields.System.Title: RET-402 — Restock as graded
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want usable-but-not-new returns held as graded stock, so
that they can be sold as second-quality without being mixed with new stock.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a grade below "as new" but above "scrap", then the stock can be restocked as
  • graded.
  • - Given graded stock, then it is held in a separate location and is distinguishable from
  • new stock in every availability query.
  • - Given an order for the product as new, then graded stock is never allocated to it.
  • - Given a customer or channel that accepts graded stock, then it can be allocated
  • explicitly.
  • - Given graded stock, then its grade travels with it through picking and packing.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | returns, inventory |
| Tables | disposition, stock_balance |
| Risks | Graded stock mixed with new and shipped as new ([doc 05 WF 9](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
